findings.message: Codex review of TASK-044 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Versioned prompt template registry implementation is complete and properly integrated.

PromptTemplateRegistryPort provides clean outbound port interface with resolve_template, list_versions, and get_regression_fixtures methods, properly abstracting template resolution from implementation.

InRepoPromptTemplateRegistry implements sophisticated resolution logic: scores candidates by locale/role/age-band compatibility, selects newest semantic version among best matches, enforces Polish for kid/child age-band, supports version pinning.
Versioned templates in data/ai/prompt_templates.json cover all use-cases (creation help/explain, gameplay hints, parent script explain/refactor) with proper locale variants and semantic versioning.
Regression fixtures in data/ai/prompt_regression_fixtures.json are tracked in-repo for quality-gate validation, enabling consistent and reproducible testing.

Service integration is comprehensive: RequestAICreationHelpService (ai_creation_help, ai_creation_explain), RequestGameplayHintService (gameplay_hint), ParentScriptEditorService (parent_script_explain, parent_script_refactor) all consume registry templates.
Backward compatibility maintained: when registry is not injected, services fall back to existing prompts, ensuring no breaking changes for existing code paths.

Test coverage is thorough: run_task_044_tests.gd passes with Tests: 3  Checks: 27  Failed tests: 0. Integration contract verifies Polish-default kid path, parent override, and prompt content resolution.
Handoff documentation (TASK-044-handoff-to-claude.md) is comprehensive, documenting all implementation details, validation results, and acceptance criteria mapping.

summary: APPROVE. TASK-044 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. Versioned prompt template registry with in-repo fixtures is fully operational and integrated. All acceptance criteria are met: templates properly versioned, fixtures tracked, parent override enforced. The copilot cross review confirms all findings and validates the implementation.
